main.description: Generic free-form LLM chat primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps task_generic_llm_chat — replaces per-actor LLM-only py_primitive nodes (animeka_*.generate_storyboard / generate_background / generate_scene_text, etc.) with a single data-resolved tool. Config-only prompt + tier; node binders pass `system` / `user` / `maxTokens` / `temperature` / `tier` via config.args.

tier.description: Model tier (e.g. fast / deep / structured). Default: fast.

schema.description: Response from underlying task_generic_llm_chat (content + usage + raw envelope as available).
